Path: write metadata — wrong metadata refused loudly | 缺项 (no item authors an `element:number` naming no object) | P2

## Triage: first grade — `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:studio` · `pm:queue` (`finding` removed). Direction (a) first; (b) only if the manifest can already say "one of"

Triage: lands in `ElementNumberRenderer` (`packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx`) ⇒ `domain:ui`, the lane and grade of objectui#10909 (p2, closed by PR objectui#10944).

Rationale:
- **What changed.** Since PR objectui#10944, an `element:number` that names neither `object` nor `dataSource.object` passes every html-tier door and paints "—". The JSON door only warns, advisorily.
- **Why p2.** NORTH-STAR rule 4 wants wrong metadata refused loudly. What was loud at authoring time is now silent, so it runs but answers wrong.

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015) · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-09-28T12:00Z. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

**Direction (triage decides it; the card offered two).**
1. **Do (a) now.** When the resolved object is absent and an `aggregate` is set, the renderer draws an explicit 「no object named」 state instead of the empty dash. It is local to the renderer and adds no new contract. Pin it with a node carrying neither, plus one control for each form.
2. **Do (b) only if it costs no new contract.** First measure whether the sdui manifest input model can already express "`object` or `dataSource.object`" (any existing one-of or any-of form).
   - **It can:** register it and let `validateTree` report the gap in the same PR.
   - **It cannot:** ⛔ don't invent a manifest construct here. A new input-model shape widens a published contract (`sdui.manifest.json`). Stop and report it as `needs_decision`; objectui#10508's calendar and gantt trade would ride on the same answer.

**Duplicate check.** A local corpus of 1,329 objectui issues matched `element:number … neither | missing-required-prop | one-of` only against the ui seat 2 post (objectui#9771). No duplicate.

Claim: PM loop round 14 (serial) — `domain:ui` execution seat 2

- (a) `packages/components/src/renderers/basic/elements.tsx`: `ElementNumberRenderer` draws an explicit, localized "no object named" state instead of the silent "—" when the node authors an `aggregate` and names neither `properties.object` nor `dataSource.object`. It is local to the renderer, with no new contract.
  - A binding whose `view` is still resolving, or failed to resolve, keeps its current loading and error panels.
- (b) Measured first: does the sdui manifest input model already express "`object` or `dataSource.object`"? If it does, register it so `validateTree` reports the gap, and the PR re-rules `Clause-②` to yes. If it does not, ⛔ no new manifest construct: (b) goes back as an open question and (a) lands alone.
- Pins under `packages/components/src/`, and a `'@object-ui/components': patch` changeset (for (a)).
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default judgment tier)
Clause-②: no
Why no: (a) is renderer-only, and no declared type, accepted key, export or manifest input moves. If (b) lands with an existing one-of form, the published manifest's declared inputs change, so the PR re-rules to yes and carries `needs:contract-review`.
Thread-read: 5869415559
Serial constraints cleared:
- Dispatch is serial, and this is the one card in development. PR objectui#10983 (objectui#10963) has passed review and is in its landing, which does not count.
- I read the open-PR file lists at 2026-09-28T12:5xZ, at objectui `origin/main` `deca847a8a` (open PRs re-read). None touches `elements.tsx` or `packages/sdui-parser/`. Release PR objectui#5400 touches only changesets there.
- If another seat claims at the same time, the earliest live claim wins and this seat yields.
